findings.title: Handoff corrupted to 3.4 MB by an empty-string replace (fixed in review#2)
findings.detail:
c4b07564a grew the handoff from 5 KB to 3.4 MB (31k lines). A scripted edit sliced the file between '### Resume' and '## Progress', but '## Progress' matched inside '### Progress', so the slice came out empty. Replacing an empty string inserts the new text between every character. The Goal, the earlier Progress and the traceability table were lost, and the brief came out at 3.3 MB. review#2 rebuilt the handoff from d7daef4a8 and brought it up to date.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Edit handoffs with an exact-match edit tool, never a computed slice. Worth a friction issue: norn could warn on, or cut, a handoff that size before it goes into the brief.
